method: editor + terminal window with real source and real captured output (option 3)
notes: The repo (Truck-go/truckgo-ai, private, one commit, March 2023) has no UI and no service: three short Python scripts, a sample data.json of 18 orders and a saved model kmeans_model.joblib. The image is an editor pane over a terminal pane. Editor: verbatim lines of kmeans_training_code.py with their real line numbers (14-17, 28-29, 40-41, 46-47, 54-55, 57-58, 63-64, 67-69); the thin rules mark where lines were skipped, nothing was added or reworded. Terminal: output captured in a copy (run/truckgo-ai, Python 3.9 venv with the repo's pinned numpy/pandas/scikit-learn/joblib, fully offline): (1) lines 1-4 and 54-69 of the same script piped to python - they load the model file committed in the repo and predict the cluster of two locations; (2) a one-line python command printing that committed model's five cluster centres (the script has this print commented out at line 43). Commands are in fl/truckgo-ai/session.sh, raw capture in session.out. DOUBTS FOR THE OWNER: (a) the script does not run end to end as committed - the training step (line 41) fails because the date column is still in the matrix - so only its load-and-predict half was run, against the model file the repo already contains; the training lines are shown as source only. (b) anticipate_the_cost.py (random-forest cost estimate) also fails as committed (it feeds the raw origin objects to the model), so nothing from it is shown. (c) The catalogue line 'Pricing and matching service for freight' describes more than the repo holds: it is an early experiment (k-means clustering of order origins plus a cost-prediction attempt), not a running service - consider rewording. data.json contains a test user record with a name and a placeholder phone number; none of it appears in the image. The window title and tab label are chrome I wrote.
